understood_as: One frozen evaluation of existing policies to distinguish time-dependent choices from responses to current physical observations; no new training or post-result intervention selection.
randomness: Mode seed=60000+1000*learner_seed+layout. Sample seed=61000+1000*learner_seed+64*layout+repeat. Reuse same seeds across conditions. Forced NOOPs do not consume action keys.
temporary_block: On first policy action that would cross a wall in mutant, select the fixed transition computed from the same pre-state; all later transitions mutant. Never step an already stepped state. Intervention bookkeeping is excluded from actor inputs.
detour_measure: Operational proxy: earliest subsequent successful movement with nonzero displacement perpendicular to the FIRST blocked dash direction, searched until episode termination. This need not be the first subsequent movement; first departure is recorded separately. Record position and absolute/control tick; do not equate lateral movement alone with successful rerouting. Also record later wall passes, retries, and full path.
time_pairs: Within policy/selection/layout/repeat/kernel, compare delay2/5 observations with the earliest matching delay0 observation with exactly equal map, goal, and numeric features except remaining_world_fraction, also asserting equal position/direction. Within each episode compare later visits with its earliest non-time-input match. Record tick, probabilities, argmax changes, pair counts and represented layouts/episodes. No matches means unavailable, not no time effect. No synthetic extra time sweep.
controls: Delay0 raw episode parity against saved original evaluations
NOOP delay changes only tick in all initial states
one temporary block, one tick advancement
limits: Existing five successful pretraining seeds and same transformed fixture; not independent seed replication or new-layout generalization. Time-only matched-input action changes do not demonstrate memory or kernel inference.
